_doc: All tunable game data. Times are real seconds. Change balance here, not in code.

world._doc: EHT-style: the whole farm (core 12 x 20 tiles of 16 px) fits one phone screen; a wooded border fills the rest.

crops._doc: Monster crops. frame = Tiny Dungeon tile index.

workers._doc: Workers are named after commenters. Until real comments arrive, Mochi's made-up villagers (snack names). frames = Tiny Dungeon people. Hire cost = hireBase x hireMult^n. Workers buy seeds themselves when the farm runs out.

kelvin._doc: Kelvin schemes in daylight where you can see him: tap him before he finishes to fine him. Max schemes per day. Losses happen at once; the morning bill refunds only part of them (refundPct), so catching him matters. Losses stay small and capped.

vote.question: What do I water the first seeds with?

goal._doc: First goal: earn this many coins in total to buy the farm back from Kelvin (his first bill said TOTAL: YOUR FARM).
